_key.description: Genomic element key, strand token, source file accession and biosample term joined by underscores.

bed_score.description: Score column of the source BED file, which sets how dark the feature is drawn in a genome browser, on a scale of 0 to 1000.

strand.description: Strand the tile was tested in: '+' or '-', or '.' where the reference sequence design does not record one.

log2FC.description: Fold change in reporter activity for the element: its normalized output (RNA) over input (DNA) ratio, in log2 space.

DNA_count.description: Input count (DNA), normalized to counts per million and averaged across replicates.

RNA_count.description: Output count (RNA), normalized to counts per million and averaged across replicates.

neg_log10_pvalue.description: -log10 of the P-value for the element's activity. Null when the source file does not report one.

neg_log10_pvalue_adj.description: -log10 of the FDR-adjusted P-value (Q-value) for the element's activity. Null when the source file does not report one.

significant.description: Whether the element's activity passes the significance threshold applied at load time: a neg_log10_pvalue_adj of 1 or more, equivalent to an FDR of 0.1 or lower. False when no adjusted P-value is available.

label.description: Reference-tile (REF) MPRA activity; not alternate-allele–specific element effects.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the file this measurement was read from.

biological_context.description: Plain-language summary of the biosample the assay was run in, taken from the file's fileset metadata. Null when the fileset carries no summary.
biological_context.example: glutamatergic neuron differentiated cell specimen, pooled cell specimen from IGVFDO6638HIAD

biosample_term.description: Ontology term for the biosample the assay was run in, taken from the file's fileset metadata. Null when the fileset lists no sample.

treatments_term_ids.description: Ontology term identifiers for the treatments applied to the samples for the purpose of perturbation, taken from the file's fileset metadata. Null when none were applied.

accessible_via.return: _id, strand, log2FC, bed_score, DNA_count, RNA_count, significant, neg_log10_pvalue, neg_log10_pvalue_adj, source, source_url
